source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U06: Reconcile section13(7) costs,secured dues and residue

payload.title: Reconcile realisations before allocating the residue
payload.core_explanation_md:
The retained section13(7) describes the treatment of money received after the relevant measure: absent a contrary contract,it is held in trust and applied first to properly incurred costs,charges and expenses,then to secured-creditor dues,with the residue paid to the person entitled under their rights and interests. The legal qualification and competing claims must be checked before applying this as a live distribution instruction.

For a stipulated exercise,show gross proceeds,qualifying costs,the amount available for debt,the amount applied and the remaining residue or shortfall. Do not count the same cost twice or call a surplus additional bank interest. The arithmetic does not settle a disputed cost entitlement or insolvency priority.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a positive residue automatically become lender income?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the person entitled under the applicable rights.

payload.title: Separate gross proceeds from residue
payload.core_explanation_md: For this exercise,no contrary contract,other priority or competing entitlement applies. Realisation is INR3,260,000,proper costs INR110,000 and secured dues INR2,870,000.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: A stipulated section13(7) exercise has INR4,120,000 proceeds,INR145,000 proper costs and INR3,640,000 secured dues. No contrary contract or other priority applies. What residue remains in INR?
payload.correct_explanation_md: 4,120,000−145,000−3,640,000=INR335,000. Legal entitlement to the residue is a separate issue.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.

payload.stem_md: The reconciliation credits all gross proceeds to debt and separately asks the borrower to pay costs already retained from those proceeds. What is the problem?

options.text_md: Gross and net proceeds must always be identical
Costs never need a legal basis
options.explanation_md: They must qualify under the applicable rule.

options.text_md: The lender may keep any excess automatically
options.explanation_md: The residue has a separate entitlement.

options.text_md: The accounting must avoid double recovery of the same costs
options.explanation_md: Reconcile the actual application of each amount.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Reconcile the actual application of each amount.

payload.title: Recovery reconciliation file
payload.scenario_narrative_md: A valid measure is stipulated for an arithmetic-only exercise. The sale team supplies gross proceeds and a documented list of proper costs. The loan team supplies the secured dues. No contrary contract or competing priority applies. Reconcile the amounts and identify whether a repeated cost demand duplicates an amount already retained.
